column1: # Dictionary headwords misread by the OCR, corrected where the lexicon is read (scripts/headword_corrections.py). The lexicon file keeps the parser's output.

column4: The entry defines 'a valuable cinchona bark obtained from Cinchona Calisaya, a Bolivian tree' (scan p. 74, https://archive.org/details/b21780535/page/n74); two independent reviews of 25 Nov 2026 read the printed headword as CALISAYA-BARK. Found by tagging the Kew Ceylon volumes.
